items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Tom wanted the cornet playing. He said, get your cornet. We'll all show you. And Eddie Vinson played a vowel trombone you know. And he drilled me through what we were going to play.

ctx.x: Well, I think we only have a couple minutes left. Can you tell us anything about Eddie Vinson? Because naturally he's dead and we'll never learn much about him, but people like you could tell us a little about him.
He was a good musician. He could play pretty well. When I was a kid when I first met him, you see, him and Tom were always together. They lived in the first house down that land.
John Soxland, John Soxland they call it.
